mapper.select: SELECT id, building_code, road_address, jibun_address, bld_nm, dong_nm, pnu, latitude, longitude, sigungu_cd FROM building WHERE id = #{buildingId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO safety ( building_id, safe_category, count_within500m, nearest_distance_meters, update_at )
VALUES ( #{buildingId}, #{safeCategory}, #{countWithin500m}, #{nearestDistanceMeters}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
count_within500m = VALUES(count_within500m),
nearest_distance_meters = VALUES(nearest_distance_meters),
update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO safety_detail ( safe_id, safe_name, latitude, longitude, distance_m, sort_order, polygon )
VALUES
( #{item.safeId}, #{item.safeName}, #{item.latitude}, #{item.longitude}, #{item.distanceM}, #{item.sortOrder}, #{item.polygon,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
